description: Evict a cached result from a crabcrop server. The path is the cached URL's remainder after its signature (operations and source; a preset URL works as-is, the server expands it). Requires the signing secret (argument or CRABCROP_SECRET). Returns how many entries were removed. For safety the request only goes to the configured CRABCROP_BASE origin (a base argument must match it) and paths with dot segments are refused: this tool will not POST to arbitrary endpoints.

base.description: crabcrop endpoint origin. Defaults to CRABCROP_BASE; its origin must match CRABCROP_BASE.

path.description: Remainder of the cached URL, e.g. "300x200/https://example.com/a.jpg".

secret.description: Signing secret. Defaults to CRABCROP_SECRET. Sensitive, deprecated: prefer the CRABCROP_SECRET environment variable; a per-call secret is kept in client transcripts.

name: purge_result
